
## Sample Relationships and Expression Distributions

PCA uses genes with mean TPM > 1 across samples and log2(TPM + 1) expression. Each point is a sample, colors indicate groups, and axis percentages show explained variance. Check within-group consistency and possible outliers together with experimental metadata.

Expression violin and box plots show the distribution of log2(TPM + 1). Comparable distributions support cross-sample comparability; they do not by themselves establish the absence of batch effects. The mean-TPM filter differs from the detected-gene union reported in the summary.

```{python}
#| label: plot-pca
from bioreport.config import display_path
if tpm_file and os.path.exists(tpm_file) and os.path.exists(meta_file):
    fig, config_plot = draw_pca_plotly(tpm_file=tpm_file, meta_file=meta_file, height_num=pca_settings.get('height', 500), width_num=pca_settings.get('width', 1000), scale_num=7)
    show_figure(fig, config=config_plot, evidence={'kind': 'pca', 'samples': [str(name) for trace in fig.data if trace.showlegend for name in trace.text]}, caption='Sample PCA: genes with mean TPM > 1; TPM is transformed as Log2(TPM + 1). Colors indicate groups and axes show explained variance. Label placement does not change PCA coordinates.')
    display_result_ai('rna.results.samples__pca')
    sample_count = sum((len(t.x) for t in fig.data if t.showlegend))
    typst_note(f'PCA includes {sample_count} matched samples; each point represents one sample. Full expression matrix (relative to data directory): {display_path(tpm_file)}')
else:
    raise FileNotFoundError(f'PCA requires a TPM matrix and sample metadata: {tpm_file}, {meta_file}')
```

```{python}
#| label: plot-dist
from bioreport.config import display_path
if tpm_file and os.path.exists(tpm_file) and os.path.exists(meta_file):
    fig, conf = draw_expression_distribution_plotly(tpm_file=tpm_file, meta_file=meta_file, threshold=distribution_settings.get('threshold', 1), width_num=distribution_settings.get('width', 1000), height_num=distribution_settings.get('height', 500))
    if fig:
        show_figure(fig, config=conf, caption=f"Sample expression distribution: genes with mean TPM > {distribution_settings.get('threshold', 1)}; y-axis: Log2(TPM + 1); colors indicate sample groups.")
        display_result_ai('rna.results.samples__distribution')
        typst_note(f"Expression distribution includes {len(fig.layout.meta['sample_order'])} samples and {fig.layout.meta['retained_genes']} retained genes; samples follow group and within-group input order. Full expression matrix (relative to data directory): {display_path(tpm_file)}")
else:
    raise FileNotFoundError(f'Expression distribution requires a TPM matrix and sample metadata: {tpm_file}, {meta_file}')
```
